metric.position_error: Mean scan error within each Query group, in sorted unique query_groups order.
metric.aggregation: Pool position errors within each listed group separately at each K; P90 uses numpy.quantile default linear interpolation.
metric.pairing_unit: (dataset, building, target floor, repeat, Query group), bound to exactly equal Query row indices and group labels across all K and methods.
metric.repeats: UJI r0/r1/r2 retain separate sampling identities. Pooled denominators count position-repeat units and do not assert independent physical positions.
metric.K_handling: K1/K3/K5 are three repeated measurements of each pairing unit. No performance summary pools the three K into independent positions.
metric.change_sign: error_at_to_K minus error_at_from_K; improvement is below -tie_tolerance_m, tie is absolute change within tolerance, worsening is above tolerance.
metric.large_worsening: Strictly greater than 5 metres increase in position error.
metric.inference: Descriptive counts and fractions only; no statistical significance analysis.

timing_scope.event_timer: law_bench.run timer surrounds model.predict plus score/diagnostics assignment. It excludes source fit/loading, raw data load, task construction, and JSON event writing.
timing_scope.source_fit_timer: Recorded refi source_models/refi.json seconds include fit_source and model joblib serialization. These are original source fits reused by the completed tasks, not new training in this analysis.
timing_scope.GP_path_timer: diagnostics.gp_seconds surrounds GP predict_scores, covering history field cache loading and any missing-field fitting, Support adaptation, retained-field preparation/readout, and Query RSS matching/projection. It excludes error scoring against Query labels and is not an isolated online inference latency.
timing_scope.GP_component_export: retained_gp reuses the complete run GP predictions and its gp_seconds; it performs no second GP evaluation and must not be added as independent cost.
timing_scope.public_Tab_timer: Original tabicl event seconds cover model.predict with deployment H/S context and Query scoring. No project source-training updates.
timing_scope.comparability: These are actual run records with their original cache/warm-start/environment conditions. No separately instrumented steady-state per-Query online latency was recorded.

UJI_history_field_construction.scope: The completed UJI extension is cache-only. Original full-H field construction time is absent from these execution records and is excluded from event timings.
